fact: A DHIS2 tracker for the Gaza emergency was rolled out in under 10 working days at 30 hospitals by the Ministry of Health and Population, after a first locally developed DHIS2 platform built by experts from the ministry, the planning ministry, UNICEF Egypt and HISP MENA, hosted on a local data centre, as at January 2024.
title: Egypt deploys DHIS2 for emergency and humanitarian response
